## Change

F1. Clear move/attack/summon/set/position lines and target highlights after bounded nonzero duration. Replacement/cancel clears pending teardown timer. Existing reduced-motion duration0 static feedback remains unchanged.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN checks expiry boundary and cleanup. Parent reviewed timer replacement/generation/animation cancellation; reran 11 controller/presentation tests. Real production controller + FieldLines Chromium harness: parent rerun 1 passed.
V2. Worker related: 211; contracts: 87; typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Controlled production-component browser proof, not whole engine duel. Other notice/life-point/chain behavior unchanged. CI has sampled acquisition failures; no full-CI-green claim.
